200.html:
data [required]

[object]

The open Agent Health issues on this page.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes of an open Agent Health issue.

category

string

The category of the issue, such as configuration. Omitted when not set.

description

string

The description of the issue. Omitted when empty.

first_seen_at

date-time

The time the issue was first seen, in RFC 3339 format. Omitted when empty.

issue_name [required]

string

The human-readable name of the issue.

issue_type [required]

string

The machine-readable type of the issue.

resource_id [required]

string

The identifier of the affected resource, interpreted according to resource_kind: hostname for host, DaemonSet UID for deployment (node Agent), cluster UUID for cluster, hostname of the host running the Cluster Agent for cluster_agent, or OpenTelemetry collector ID for otel.

resource_kind [required]

string

The kind of affected resource. Known values are host, deployment, cluster, cluster_agent, and otel.

resource_type

string

The type of the affected resource. Omitted when empty.

severity [required]

string

The severity of the issue. Known values are low, medium, high, and unknown.

state [required]

string

The state of the issue. Only issues with state open are returned.

tags

[string]

Tags associated with the issue. Omitted when empty.

title

string

The title of the issue. Omitted when empty.

updated_at

date-time

The time the issue was last updated, in RFC 3339 format. Omitted when empty.

id [required]

string

The unique identifier of the issue.

type [required]

enum

The Agent Health issue resource type. Allowed enum values: agent_health_issues

meta [required]

object

Pagination metadata for the matching Agent Health issues.

page [required]

object

Pagination counts for the Agent Health issues.

total_count [required]

int64

The total number of open issues in the organization, ignoring filters.

total_filtered_count [required]

int64

The total number of open issues matching the filters, across all pages.

200.html:
data [required]

object

An open Agent Health issue with available remediation.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes of an open Agent Health issue, including available remediation.

category

string

The category of the issue, such as configuration. Omitted when not set.

description

string

The description of the issue. Omitted when empty.

first_seen_at

date-time

The time the issue was first seen, in RFC 3339 format. Omitted when empty.

issue_name [required]

string

The human-readable name of the issue.

issue_type [required]

string

The machine-readable type of the issue.

remediation

object

Remediation for the issue. Omitted when no remediation is available.

script

object

A script that can be used to remediate the issue.

content

string

The content of the script.

filename

string

The filename of the script.

language

string

The language of the script.

language_version

string

The language version used by the script.

requires_root

boolean

Whether the script requires root privileges.

steps

[object]

Steps to remediate the issue.

order

int64

The order in which to perform the step.

text

string

The instructions for the step.

summary

string

A summary of how to remediate the issue.

resource_id [required]

string

The identifier of the affected resource, interpreted according to resource_kind: hostname for host, DaemonSet UID for deployment (node Agent), cluster UUID for cluster, hostname of the host running the Cluster Agent for cluster_agent, or OpenTelemetry collector ID for otel.

resource_kind [required]

string

The kind of affected resource. Known values are host, deployment, cluster, cluster_agent, and otel.

resource_type

string

The type of the affected resource. Omitted when empty.

severity [required]

string

The severity of the issue. Known values are low, medium, high, and unknown.

state [required]

string

The state of the issue. Only issues with state open are returned.

tags

[string]

Tags associated with the issue. Omitted when empty.

title

string

The title of the issue. Omitted when empty.

updated_at

date-time

The time the issue was last updated, in RFC 3339 format. Omitted when empty.

id [required]

string

The unique identifier of the issue.

type [required]

enum

The Agent Health issue resource type. Allowed enum values: agent_health_issues
